fusions.name: Shoal Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 5 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 water damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Harpoon
fusions.desc: Fires a barbed arrow that deals 12 water damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Increases your piercing damage by 25% for 10 seconds, and gives you 20% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Silver Run
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
